name: Freeze Frame
description: Increases ATK by 12%. After inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target, the wielder gains 30% Glacio DMG Bonus for 12s, and all Resonators in the team gain 24% ATK increase for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Spectral Trigger
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Resonance Skill grants 20% Spectro DMG Bonus to the wielder for 14s, stacking up to 2 times. Inflicting Hack - Shifting grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification to the wielder for 14s, during which Heavy Attack DMG ignores 10% of the target's DEF.

name: Skull Thrasher
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Intro Skill grants 24% Basic Attack DMG Bonus to the wielder for 14s. Inflicting Hack - Shifting grants 12% Basic Attack DMG Bonus to the wielder for 14s, and increases the ATK of Resonators in the team by 24% for 30s. Effects of the same name do not stack.

name: Forged Dwarf Star
description: Increases ATK by 12%. When the wielder inflicts Fusion Burst Effect or Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, it increases their Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus by 36% for 5s. Under this effect, when Resonators in the team inflict Fusion Burst Effect or Tune Strain - Shifting, their ATK is increased by 24% for 15s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Frostburn
description: ATK is increased by 12%. When the wielder applies Glacio Chafe, Glacio DMG is Amplified by 28%, and Resonance Liberation DMG ignores 10% of the target's DEF for 20s. If the wielder is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Chafe DMG dealt to all targets within a certain range is Amplified by 20% for 6s. This effect can be triggered up to 1 time every 0.1s. Only the strongest effect of the same name applies.

name: Solsworn Ciphers
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Intro Skill or Echo Skill grants 32% Echo Skill DMG Amplification for 15s. When dealing Echo Skill DMG, Aero DMG ignores 10% of the target's DEF for 6s.

name: Daybreaker's Spine
description: Increases ATK by 12%. After dealing Basic Attack DMG, the wielder gains 20% Spectro DMG Bonus for 4s. Each time after the wielder inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, they gain 20% Basic Attack DMG Amplification and their Basic Attack DMG ignores 10% of the target's DEF for 6s.

name: Everbright Polestar
description: Increase All-Attribute DMG Bonus by 12%. When inflicting Tune Repture - Shifting or Fusion Burst, the wielder's Resonance Liberation DMG ignores 32% DEF and 10% Fusion RES on targets for 8s.

name: Starfield Calibrator
description: Increases DEF by 16%. Casting Resonance Liberation restores 8 points of Concerto Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 20s. When the wielder heals Resonators, increases Crit. DMG of all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 4s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Spectrum Blaster
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Intro Skill or hitting the target with Basic Attack increases the wielder's Basic Attack DMG by 36% for 4s. Each time the wielder inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting during Basic Attacks, all DMG dealt by Resonators in the team is increased by 8% for 30s, up to 3 stacks. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Radiance Cleaver
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Dealing damage to targets under Tune Strain - Interfered grants 24% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 3s. Retriggering the effect resets its duration.

name: Laser Shearer
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Dealing damage to targets under Tune Strain - Interfered grants 24% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 3s. Retriggering the effect resets its duration.

name: Phasic Homogenizer
description: Increases ATK by 12%. After a Resonator in the team casts a Tune Break skill, it grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus to the wielder for 14s.

name: Pulsation Bracer
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Dealing damage to targets under Tune Strain - Interfered grants 6% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 3s, stacking up to 4 times. This effect can be triggered 1 time(s) every 0.5s. Retriggering the effect resets its duration.

name: Boson Astrolabe
description: Increases ATK by 12%. After a Resonator in the team casts a Tune Break skill, it grants a 12% ATK increase and 12% Basic Attack DMG Bonus to the wielder for 14s.

name: Kumokiri
description: ATK is increased by 12%. When the wielder casts Intro Skill or inflicts Negative Statuses, they gain 8% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus, stacking up to 3 times for 15s. At max stacks, when Resonators in the team inflict Negative Statuses, they gain 24% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 15s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Emerald Sentence
description:
ATK is increased by 12%. Casting Echo Skill within 10s after casting Echo Skill or Basic Attack grants 1 stack of "Bamboo Cleaver", which grants 30% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus to the wielder. This effect can be triggered by Echoes of the same name once only, stacking up to 2 times, lasting for 12s. Casting Echo Skill at max stacks does not reset the duration. This effect can be triggered once every 10s and ends early if the wielder is switched off the field.
Casting Intro Skill grants 20% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Lux & Umber
description: ATK is increased by 12%. Upon dealing Echo Skill DMG, gain 24% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 6s. Upon dealing Heavy Attack DMG, gain 24% Echo Skill DMG Amplification for 6s. DMG Amplification on each attack is capped at 24%. While both effects are active, dealing damage ignores 8% of the target's DEF.

name: Moongazer’s Sigil
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Intro Skill or Resonance Liberation increases Resonance Liberation DMG by 20% for 15s. Obtaining Shield allows Resonance Liberation DMG to ignore 7.2% of the target’s DEF for 7s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect is triggered once every 0.5s. Upon casting Intro Skill, this effect reaches max stacks immediately, lasting for 3s.

name: Thunderflare Dominion
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Intro Skill or Resonance Skill increases Heavy Attack DMG by 20% for 15s. Obtaining Shield allows Heavy Attack DMG to ignore 7.2% of the target's DEF for 7s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect is triggered once every 0.5s

name: Lethean Elegy

name: Wildfire Mark

Each successful extension gives 24% Fusion DMG Bonus to all Resonators in the team for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Defier's Thorn
description: Max HP is increased by 12%. 15s after casting Intro Skill or Basic Attacks, ignores 8% of the target's DEF. If the target has Aero Erosion, DMG taken is amplified by 20%.

name: Blazing Justice
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Casting Basic Attack grants the following effects: Dealing damage ignores 8% of the target's DEF and amplifies Spectro Frazzle DMG dealt by 50% for 6s. Retriggering the effect resets its duration.

description: Providing Healing increases Resonance Skill DMG by 10% for 6s. When Rover Aero casts Resonance Skill Unbound Flow, Aero DMG dealt by nearby Resonators is amplified by 10% for 30s.

name: Whispers of Sirens

Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once, stacking up to 2 times, lasting for 10s. When reaching 2 stacks, casting Echo Skill no longer resets the duration of this effect. This effect activates up to once per 10s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect early. With 1 stack: Grants 40% Basic Attack DMG Bonus. With 2 stacks: Ignores 12% of the target's Havoc RES.

name: Unflickering Valor
description: Increase Crit Rate by 8%. Casting Resonance Liberation grants 24% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10s. Dealing Basic Attack DMG grants 24% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 4s.

name: Luminous Hymn

name: Tragicomedy
description: Increases ATK by 12%. Every time Basic Attack or Intro Skill is cast, Heavy Attack DMG Bonus increases by 48% for 3s.

name: The Last Dance

name: Red Spring

name: Stellar Symphony
description: Increase HP by 12%. Restore 8 Concerto Energy when casting Resonance Liberation. This effect can be triggered 1 time(s) every 20s. When casting Resonance Skill that heals, increase nearby party members' ATK by 14% for 30s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.

name: Verity's Handle
description: Gain 12% Attribute DMG Bonus. When using Resonance Liberation, the wielder gains 48% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 8s. This effect can be extended by 5s each time Resonance Skills are cast, up to 3 times.

name: Rime-Draped Sprouts

When casting Outro Skill with 3 stacks, consume all stacks to give 52% DMG Bonus to the off-field Basic Attacks performed by the equipped Resonator, lasting for 27s.

name: Blazing Brilliance
